rationale: All three lines of this run now carry final dispositions, interpretations with scoped defect claims or refutations, promoted knowledge and answered or closed gaps, so this final update adds only the one durable hook that is still missing rather than restating or repeating anything. The VerifyLeader finding is settled and its result does not depend on the demoted node's own configuration view, yet two executions of the extended-window harness (2444815cf0d84e06917efa1091d12257 and f8a32ad3a4de41538ef20a142ae947bc, index 0 of each) reported that node's GetConfiguration as still holding a vote at setup time, after a bounded three second poll, while every construction that samples that view together with the node's own LastIndex - three to four runs in each of two receipts, plus a native run of the retained harness with added sampling - shows it converging within one 20ms sample and never stale once the log holds the entry. That observation is currently only recorded as counterevidence and a limitation; registering it as a gap under its own investigation gives it an owner and a question that later work can discriminate without reopening the settled claim.

gaps.question: Why did the extended-window harness's setup event report the demoted node's own configuration view as still holding a vote, in two executions, when every construction that samples that node's view against its own LastIndex shows it converging within one 20ms sample and never stale once the log contains the configuration entry?
